resource.title: Project Evaluation (MIT 1.011, Spring 2011) — MIT OpenCourseWare
resource.access: MIT OpenCourseWare 免费开放，无需注册；提供 Syllabus、Calendar、Readings、Lecture Notes、Assignments、Exams、Projects。教材 Martland《Toward More Sustainable Infrastructure: Project Evaluation for Planners and Engineers》(Wiley, 2011) 需自行购买
resource.covers: Syllabus 原文：'Students learn the basic techniques of engineering economics, including net present value analysis, life-cycle costing, benefit-cost analysis, and other approaches to project evaluation. There is an emphasis on the role of uncertainty in project evaluation.' 覆盖资金时间价值（现值分析）、方案比选（benefit-cost）、成本估算（life-cycle costing）、不确定性分析；内部收益率、折旧与税、盈亏平衡与敏感性分析未在概述中点名（未核对讲义逐讲）
resource.publisher: MIT OpenCourseWare（课程页面标注 Level: Undergraduate；属土木与环境工程系的项目评价课）

courses.course: CEE 3230 / ENGRG 3230 Engineering Economics and Management
courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: or corequisites: CEE 3040 or ENGRD 2700 or ILRST 2100 or STSCI 2200 or AEM 2100 or permission of instructor.
courses.scope_text: Introduction to engineering and business economics investment alternatives and to project management. Intended to give students a working knowledge of money management and how to make economic comparisons of alternatives involving future benefits and cost. The impact of inflation, taxation, depreciation, financial planning, economic optimization, project scheduling, and legal and regulatory issues are introduced and applied to economic investment and planning and project-management problems. Learning Outcomes 原文：'Gain a working knowledge of money management and how to make economic comparisons of alternative engineering designs or projects.'
courses.hours_text: ENGRG 3230 - Engineering Economics and Management (3 Credits)

courses.course: 工程经济学（国家精品在线开放课程）
courses.prereq_text: 预备知识：'工程建设项目费用估算基本知识'
courses.scope_text: 课程概述：'课程将工程经济学的经典知识点分为两个部分：第一部分为基础理论与方法，分为5章，包括工程经济分析思想、现金流及资金的时间价值、工程经济要素、经济评价方法、不确定性分析；第二部分为实物应用部分，分为4章，包括财务评价、费用效益分析、设备更新、价值工程。'

courses.prereq_text: （Virginia Tech 课程目录该条目未印先修要求——原文缺失，按 unspecified 记）
courses.scope_text: Concepts and techniques of analysis for evaluating the value of products/services, projects, and systems in relation to their cost. Economic and cost concepts, calculating economic equivalence, comparison of alternatives, purchase versus lease decisions, financial risk evaluation, cash flow sensitivity analysis, and after-tax analysis.
courses.hours_text: ISE 2014 - Engineering Economy (2 credits) · Instructional Contact Hours: (2 Lec, 2 Crd)

notes: 这门课的候选必须前置为空，候选推荐前置只有 M.6.1、M.1.2。M.6.1 判 supported：Cornell CEE 3230 / ENGRG 3230 把统计类课（CEE 3040『Uncertainty Analysis in Engineering』、ENGRD 2700、ILRST 2100、STSCI 2200、AEM 2100）写成 'Prerequisites: or corequisites'，其中 CEE 3040 目录原文确认是'概率论+估计+检验+回归'的统计课；也就是说真实的工程学院工程经济课把概率统计放在先修/同学期。M.1.2（一元微积分）判 not_mentioned：三门课都没有把微积分写进先修，VT ISE 2014 与川大 MOOC 的先修里也没有数学课（川大写的是'工程建设项目费用估算基本知识'，不对应任何节点）。另查过但没采用的：Penn State IE 302 Engineering Economy（https://bulletins.psu.edu/university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/ie/ 只有 3 学分与描述 'Principles and methods for analyzing the economic feasibility of technical alternatives leading to a decision or recommendation.'，无先修字段）；Cornell ORIE 5110 Engineering Economics and Strategic Decision-Making（1 学分，描述含 time value of money、discounted cash flow、capital budgeting、tax implications，但只写 'Enrollment limited to: Master of Engineering (MEng) students' 的选课限制，没有先修课）；UC Berkeley 的 ENGIN 120 页面打不开（www2.eecs.berkeley.edu/Courses/ENGIN120 返回 404，guide.berkeley.edu/courses/engin/ 已重定向到 registrar 的通用目录页），未能核对。
